topics.title: Stern’s Radio Show Meltdown
topics.summary: During a live radio show, Howard Stern reacts angrily to a negative Newsday review of his Saturday event and disputes with caller Gary. He criticizes the audience's reaction to tennis segments featuring Sam Kinison and expresses frustration over perceived press hostility, culminating in an argument with his father-in-law.

topics.title: Backstage Pass Drama and Fever
topics.summary: Howard recounts his mother's frustration over not getting backstage passes to his concert, leading to an argument about filming her experience. The conversation spirals into a chaotic discussion involving a high fever, mistaken seating arrangements, and attempts to secure a backstage pass for the party.

topics.title: Unscripted Broadcast & Hairpiece Promotion
topics.summary: The broadcast features a chaotic discussion centered around a man’s obsession with being filmed, extensive conversations about hairpieces (including one for Scott), and attempts to promote an advertiser selling custom hair weaves. Calls are taken regarding concert tickets and the unusual demand for videotapes of the show.

topics.title: Naked Women at the China Club
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard Stern and his co-hosts engage in an impromptu performance with two women from Sensation Party Entertainment brought onto the set to demonstrate hair replacement products. The interaction involves nudity, suggestive comments about attraction, and culminates in chaotic scenes at the China Club.

topics.title: 7-Eleven Encounter - Explicit Content
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, the host and guests engage in an inappropriate conversation involving suggestive comments and requests at a 7-Eleven store. The segment includes attempts to purchase coffee while discussing personal interactions and devolves into explicit scenarios with multiple female participants.
